description: Mark a standing finding as known, so the weekly summary email stops listing it: the game's owner has looked at it and accepts it (a slow first launch they chose, a freeze they can't avoid). glitchless_triage still shows it, after the rest, with `known` and the note. finding is a finding's id from glitchless_triage, or the start of one ("perf-level-tutorial_1_" covers those levels). until (YYYY-MM-DD) brings it back the day after; until_worse brings it back if it gets a quarter worse than over the last 7 days (its severity, the share of sessions it hits or its key number), and needs the finding to show now. clear: true removes the mark. Without finding, lists the game's known findings. Only the person's say-so makes a finding known: ask before marking one. Needs an Owner's or Admin's key, as alert settings do. With player or session instead of finding, marks the game's team's own play (the developer's playtest, a friend trying a build), so every read tool counts it as session type tester instead of user, its past sessions too: players' numbers, findings, the weekly summary, alerts and share links leave it out, and session_type "tester" finds it. player is the player_id glitchless_session gives (every session that player sent, before and after); session a session_id, for a game in anonymous mode (no player IDs). Ask the person first. With none of them, lists the known findings and the testers.

clear.description: Remove the mark: the weekly summary lists the finding again, or the tester's sessions count as they were sent

finding.description: A finding id from glitchless_triage, e.g. "load-ttff", or the start of one, e.g. "perf-level-tutorial_1_"

game.description: The game, by name or id, when signed in to a workspace (glitchless_list_games lists them); later calls keep it. With a key for one game (gl_sk_…), a call that names another game is refused: sign in to the workspace to reach every game.

note.description: Why it is accepted, or who the tester is, in a few words (200 characters at most), e.g. "First launch compiles shaders; accepted" or "Me, playtesting on my laptop"

player.description: Or a player_id, from glitchless_session: that player's play is the team's own (a tester)

session.description: Or a session_id (s_…): that one session is the team's own

until.description: YYYY-MM-DD: known through that day, listed again from the day after

until_worse.description: Known only while it is no worse than it is now

name: glitchless_mark_known
title: Mark known
